target.title: fix: stabilize room-event prompt cache mode
target.body:
Related: #102175

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users running Discord/channel room events with `visibleReplies: automatic` would see avoidable prompt-cache churn when an unmentioned room event interleaved with normal session turns.

The user-visible symptom from redacted live traces was that otherwise similar same-session turns alternated between mostly uncached prompts and much smaller cached prefixes, even though the session-level visible-reply contract was configured as automatic.

## Why This Change Was Made

This keeps strict room-event delivery unchanged: non-internal room events still use `message_tool_only` for actual delivery and `forceMessageTool`. The change separates the prompt-facing reply delivery mode from the effective delivery mode so embedded system-prompt construction can use the session-stable mode already computed for binding facts.

The queue delivery-context key also includes the prompt-facing mode, so collect batching does not merge turns whose prompt contracts differ.

## User Impact

Room-event turns can preserve the same prompt/cache contract as the rest of the session without relaxing message-tool-only delivery. Operators should see fewer avoidable prompt-prefix cache misses when room-event turns interleave with direct or primary session turns.

## Evidence

AI-assisted PR by Codex. Private identifiers are redacted.

Redacted live trace evidence from #102175:
- Same agent/session family, same provider/model family, repeated turns within one minute.
- Prompt input sizes around `37k-46.5k` tokens alternated with cached prefixes of `0`, `2k`, `9.9k`, and `47.6k` tokens.
- The regression correlated with room-event turns where runtime metadata reported `visible_reply_contract: message_tool_only` even though resolved config used `messages.visibleReplies: automatic`.
- Source inspection on current `main` showed strict room-event effective delivery still forcing `message_tool_only`, while cache-sensitive system-prompt sections derive prompt directives from the mode passed into prompt construction.

Local validation:
- `git diff --check`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 <10 touched files>`
- `pnpm tsgo:core`
- `OPENCLAW_VITEST_INCLUDE_FILE=.artifacts/vitest-cache-pr-auto-reply.json node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.auto-reply-reply.config.ts src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply-run.media-only.test.ts` — 98 passed.
- `OPENCLAW_VITEST_INCLUDE_FILE=.artifacts/vitest-cache-pr-embedded.json node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.unit-fast.config.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.spawn-workspace.context-engine.test.ts -t 'uses prompt-stable source reply delivery mode for embedded system prompts'` — 1 passed, 70 skipped.

Not counted as validation:
- A full run of `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.spawn-workspace.context-engine.test.ts` without `-t` produced no output for 120s and was terminated by the repository Vitest wrapper.

Disclaimer: This PR was filed autonomously by Codex on behalf of the reporter; private identifiers were stripped from the evidence before submission.
